interpretation.main: The residual v2.2 parameter ambiguity was not irreducible. It came from movement parameters that were inactive under the passive landscape. Axis-specific interventions activated those parameters and made the finite 64-world universe injective.
interpretation.P: A one-step standardized barrier-crossing challenge distinguished all eight P-only alias classes.
interpretation.H: A long barrier-free corridor distinguished all eight H-only alias classes.
interpretation.principle: More passive observation cannot identify a parameter that does not alter the observed state; a targeted intervention can if it makes competing parameter values imply different outcomes.
